reason: A removable DSH Web plugin that adds a left-side minimap for locating and navigating among user messages in long conversations.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 长对话左侧显示用户消息导航轨，支持通过标记、键盘或拖动快速定位历史指令。
summaries.en: Adds a user-message minimap to DeepSeek Harness Web conversations, allowing users to locate and jump to earlier instructions with markers, keyboard input, or dragging.

capabilities: Reads conversation-related DOM attributes in the DSH Web client
Displays a user-message minimap in the conversation interface
Navigates and scrolls to selected user messages via clicks, keyboard input, and dragging
Applies current theme styling and respects reduced-motion preferences
